The Quillamere protocol was invented by.why: Made up, so no text states it, and nothing real is contradicted: Quillamere is an invented protocol name; an unrecorded protocol could have been invented by a famous network pioneer, and invented_by is many-valued here (Cerf co-designed TCP/IP and more).

Vint Cerf co-designed the TCP/IP protoco.why: Stated in the first lines of Wikipedia's Vint Cerf article.

sources.quote: Cerf worked as assistant professor at Stanford University from 1972 to 1976 where he conducted research on packet network interconnection protocols and co-designed the DoD TCP/IP protocol suite with Kahn.
